summary: Bundle E (Onboarding Admin Wizard + SaaSHierarchyBreadcrumb + Tour fix) fully validated. Backend: 12 ASGI tests + 11 new E2E public-URL tests all PASS. Frontend: breadcrumb visible on all 7 admin pages, wizard opens via __myeOpenOnboarding(), non-blocking confirmed (pointer-events:auto, no fullscreen backdrop), close button works with R51 confirmation, tour fix verified (no target:'body' in code).

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — minor, doesn't affect functionality. Likely a <span> nested inside a <select><option> somewhere on AdminCAEHome.

action_items: (Optional) Fix the hydration warning on /admin/cae: locate <option> containing <span> child and flatten to plain text.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_onboarding.py uses get_db() inside helpers but the repo also uses tenant_id from request.state.user — looks clean, multi-tenant isolation enforced at repo + collection level.
OnboardingWizard.handleClose uses native window.confirm() — works for E2E but consider replacing with shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with rest of UI.
tours.js comments correctly reference the old anti-pattern (target: 'body'); current implementation uses data-tour-target attributes — verified clean.
test_credentials: admin@myexcellence.local / Admin123! (admin); superadmin@myexcellence.local / Admin123!; root@myexcellence.local / Admin123!; agent@myexcellence.local / Admin123! — all confirmed working via /api/auth/login
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures create ephemeral tenants/users via direct DB inserts for ASGI tests. E2E tests use existing seeded users (no extra seed data). Catalog seed via /api/admin/onboarding/seed-mx-catalog on tenant 'myexcellence' (already populated from previous runs, idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bundle E is solid. The wizard persists progress per user×tenant — admin & superadmin users in the seeded 'myexcellence' tenant already have advanced state (paso 6 de 6) from earlier smoke tests. To test step 5 (catalog mandatory banner) fresh, use POST /api/admin/onboarding/complete to reset OR delete admin_onboarding_progress doc for that user OR create a fresh tenant. Backend tenant_age_days is 30+ for 'myexcellence' so should_auto_open will be false in production sessions; use window.__myeOpenOnboarding() to force-open. Pytest config in /app/pytest.ini.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial confusion: clicking close button when wizard at step>1 triggers window.confirm; Playwright must register a dialog handler to auto-accept (page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())). This is correct R51 'guarded close' behavior, not a bug.
